Title: Run 100-document load test on prod
Description: As a QA engineer, I want to run a 100-document load test on prod so that we can prove the system handles the demo batch and is production-ready. The test submits a batch of 100+ documents to prod and monitors the pipeline for latency, errors, and resource utilization, tunes concurrency caps, queue settings, and autoscaling parameters, and verifies all documents complete successfully with correct results.
AcceptanceCriteria: Batch of 100+ test documents prepared and uploaded
Load test runs on prod environment
All documents complete without errors or timeouts
Pipeline latency is acceptable (document completes within SLA)
Container App autoscaling activates and scales up
CPU, memory, and database RU/s usage are monitored and within limits
Cost for the 100-doc run is estimated and logged
Load test results are documented with latency percentiles and resource usage
TalkingPoints: I'm going to run the full production load with 100+ docs to validate throughput, latency, and scaling. I'll monitor resources and costs. This is going to confirm the system can handle the demo batch and is production-ready.
